Even if you don't have to file a tax return, you may want to file. You may get money back: If you qualify for a refundable tax credit If your employer withheld more taxes than you owe If you owe tax, it's important to file and pay on time to avoid penalties and interest. Find the latest tax changes Ready to file now? File with an IRS Free File partner If you need more time to file If you need more time, you must request an extension by the April filing deadline . Remember, an extension of time to file is not an extension to pay taxes you owe. Pay any taxes due by the filing deadline to avoid penalties and interest.
